encounter_greeting.text: hi {player}!! im {persona} from the {my_faction} lot. sorry if we keep walking into ur road, i dont know where the roads are yet :)
ser {player}!! is that u? the {my_faction} banners look even prettier up close. thanks a ton for not stomping on my little party :)
oi {player}, stay off our side of the field!! i dont want to fight but ur kinda scary :( sorry sorry
hello {player}? is this the right road to {my_faction}?? i think i took a wrong turn near the fens lol :D

beat_by_player.text: oh no oh no we lost!! {troop_count} of my lads are running home now. ur really good at this {player}, is that bad for me?? :(
lost the field to {player} with {troop_count} men and i have no idea what i did wrong :( did i click the wrong thing again
hey {player} sorry for the mess back there!! i kinda forgot which button was attack. ur still my favorite enemy :)
{player} u won that one but i will get my {troop_count} back!! probably!! i think!! :D

released_by_player.text: omg {player} u let me go?? i was ready to pay the ransom!! ur way too kind, i owe u a whole cup of ale :)
{player} just let me walk out of captivity for free, what is happening, is this a good thing?? :D
ok {player} that was sneaky of u letting me go, i was saving up gold for that ransom!! dont think im done with u :P
shoutout to {player} for releasing me, no ransom needed, big heart!! sorry i got captured in the first place :(

fought_alongside_player.text: we WON {player}!!! {troop_count} of us against {enemy_faction} and i didnt even fall in a ditch this time. ur a legend :)
{player} u are amazing, the {enemy_faction} lines just broke!! my {troop_count} lads are still cheering :D
that was fun {player}. did i do the right thing with my troops or was i just in the way?? sorry if i was just standing there :)
thanks for pulling me out of the mess {player}!! i think i mostly ran in circles but ur the real hero :)
{troop_count} troops and one very confused newbie, we beat {enemy_faction}!! is it always this loud in battle??

whisper_beg_help.text: {player} pls help, {enemy_faction} is at the gates of {fief} and i think im losing?? i dont know what losing looks like lol :(
hi {player}, sorry to bother u. {fief} is under siege by {enemy_faction} and i dont know how to hold it. come by?? :(
ur the only person i trust with this {player}!! {fief} might fall to {enemy_faction} if i click the wrong thing again :( sorry!!
{player} if ur free, {fief} needs help against {enemy_faction}. i would pay in ale and really bad jokes :)

ambient_lfg.text: LF spare lads!! {my_faction} sieging {fief} soon, need more bodies. no experience needed (i have none) :D
siege of {fief} tonight?? {my_faction} needs help vs {enemy_faction}. ill bring the snacks and the bad jokes :)
anyone free to raid near {fief}? {my_faction} is short on troops and i dont want to be the only one there lol :(
{my_faction} forming up to hit {enemy_faction} at {fief}. pls come, i keep getting lost so ill need a buddy :(

ambient_chatter.text: does anyone know if {town} has a good tavern or is it all soup like the fens?? :D
walked from {village} to here and my feet are soup now. is that normal or is it just me :(
the weather in {town} is so grey today, i think the sky is also in the fens lol
wait is {town} the one with the big bridge?? i keep saying the wrong name to people and im so sorry :)
lag at {village} is making my horse run backwards!! anyone else? or is that just me being clumsy :(

player_joined_my_faction.text: {player} just joined {my_faction}!!! welcome!! ur gonna love it here, the banners are so shiny :D
hi {player}!! i once almost lost a whole fief to a wrong click so ask me anything :)
{player} joined {my_faction}, is that a good thing for the server?? sorry im just happy for everyone :D
oh {player} ur in {my_faction} now?? ok ok i wont ask why, ur still kinda scary tho :P
new face in {my_faction}! {player} pls dont click the big red button on the map, trust me, learned that the hard way :(

encounter_alliance_yes.text: yes yes yes {player}!! an alliance?? i have to tell the lads. dont tell {enemy_faction} we are friends, its a secret :)
ok {player}, we accept! i dont really know how alliances work but i think it means we dont stab each other? right??
good, now {rival} cant poke us for a while. sorry i dont really like {rival} but u know how it is :)
{player} ur the best, an alliance with u means i dont have to read the map alone anymore!! :D

captured_by_player.text: oh no u caught me!! fine {player}, ill pay the {gold} ransom, but dont expect me to be happy about it :(
wait so ur holding me prisoner now? sorry sorry, what do i do, do i pay {gold} or wait here?? :D
{player} caught me!! ok ok, i know ur just doing ur job. {my_faction} will pay {gold} for me, i promise :) sorry for getting caught
so u got me {player}. nice one. my {my_faction} lads will come with {gold} and then i will be back to bother u, promise :P
